_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Nationaltheatret (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), BUILDOUT O5 batch 1 (2026-10-29). Drafted from OSM only so far; facts from the operator's station page, photos or a walk go here with their source. Level names are placeholders until a plan or signage names them.

sources.note: Høydedata, © Kartverket, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/NO-NTH).
Bane NOR's station page, track table (facts): platform heights (3D research pass; data/stations/research/banenor_platforms_NO.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 1).
Platform heights from Bane NOR's station page, track table (facts); 8 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/NO-NTH).
